seasonsNote: Idaho sets separate hunt areas for ducks (3), Canada geese (4), white-fronted geese (4) and light geese (5). Each map piece shows the area numbers it falls in.

seasons.label: Canada geese
seasons.note: Canada goose Area 4 (Bear Lake / Blackfoot Reservoir) also opens Sept 1–15.

seasons.label: Light geese (snow, blue, Ross’s)
seasons.note: Light goose Areas 3 and 4, Feb 16 – Mar 10: electronic calls and unplugged shotguns allowed. Fort Boise and Payette River WMAs, Roswell Marsh south of SH 18 and Deer Flat NWR Snake River Islands closed Feb 1 – Mar 10.

seasons.label: Youth and veterans / military weekend
seasons.note: Ducks, geese and coots at regular limits. Adults may not hunt, except veterans and active military.

bags.detail: Seven ducks including mergansers, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit.

rules.d: One-half hour before sunrise to sunset; IDFG prints tables by county group (Pacific and Mountain time).
Nontoxic shot for waterfowl, coots and snipe. Shotguns limited to 3 shells, except light goose Areas 3 and 4 from Feb 16 to Mar 10.

Red: IDFG areas closed to waterfowl or goose hunting (state parks, preserves, Hubbard and Mormon reservoirs, the Spokane River below Post Falls Dam, the Hagerman Valley and the Snake River below Milner Dam for geese, and others). Amber: refuges and areas with designated-area, day or distance rules (Fort Boise, Roswell Marsh, Fort Hall, Mann’s Lake). IDFG booklet pages 27–28.
Controlled swan hunt in Benewah, Bonner, Boundary and Kootenai counties only (permit).
Sept 26–27 statewide. Federal duck stamp not required for hunters 15 and under.

geometryNote: Geometry: Census TIGER county lines; I-15 through Bonneville, Clark and Jefferson counties and US 30 / Power Plant Road (OpenStreetMap); the Blackfoot Reservoir drainage (USGS WBD HUC10s 1704020701–03); the Caribou-Targhee National Forest boundary (USFS); split against the Census TIGER outline and welded to Washington, Oregon and Nevada; USGS NHD and GNIS; USFWS (refuge units; NWI marsh).
